summary: Iteration 5 heartbeat fix (GET ?codigo=<tv_code>) verified end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases passed against POST /api/monitor/heartbeat — real falacom endpoint responds 200 'OK'; codigo normalization strips spaces, tabs, newlines, zero-width chars; existing query strings are preserved; a pre-existing 'codigo' param on server_url is replaced by the body's tv_code (exactly one 'codigo=' remains); invalid server_url returns HTTP 400 with Portuguese detail. Frontend: /settings screen — entering ' WEYEN_LOJA_01 ' (with leading/trailing spaces) and tapping settings-monitor-test-button renders the diagnostic panel with method=GET, url ending in '?codigo=WEYEN_LOJA_01' (no encoded spaces), codigo=WEYEN_LOJA_01, response=OK. Success message reads 'Heartbeat enviado com sucesso — versão 1.0.0.' and the status pill flips to 'Online'. Regression: TV code / URL / interval fields, Salvar monitoramento + Enviar teste agora buttons, and the settings-attribution 'FEITO por Tiago Rodrigues 64 9 84468273' are all still present. No React Native / Expo deprecation issues detected in the touched files.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is instantiated AFTER routes reference it (lines 232, 247, 162). Currently works because logger names are resolved at call time and the module-level logger is created before the first request, but keeping the getLogger call above the route definitions would be cleaner and more predictable.
monitoring.ts sends the raw (untrimmed) monitorTvCode to the backend on purpose so codigo_raw_length can reflect what the user typed — good behavior; keep as-is.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests hit real endpoints (falacom.com.br and httpbin.org) but do not persist data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Heartbeat proxy at POST /api/monitor/heartbeat now returns diagnostic fields (method, request_url, codigo_sent, codigo_raw_length, codigo_clean_length, status_code, response_snippet). Frontend /settings surfaces them under testID 'settings-monitor-diagnostic' with sub-testIDs settings-monitor-diag-{method,url,codigo,response}. Do NOT verify by browsing https://falacom.com.br/tv-monitor/painel/ — verify only what our app emits.
